new.s: Nickel-cadmium (Ni-Cd) rechargeable batteries have commonly been used in which of the following?

new.x: Ni-Cd batteries (nickel and cadmium electrodes, rechargeable) are used in calculators, cordless appliances, transistors, torches and shavers. Grid-scale tank storage is the flow battery; car starting is the lead-acid battery; non-rechargeable clock cells are zinc-carbon dry cells.
new.tq: Ni-Cd = calculators, cordless gadgets (PYQ 2016); declining as cadmium is toxic

new.s: With reference to the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), which one of the following statements is correct?
o: It is a statutory body under the Ministry of Power, created by the Energy Conservation Act, 2001
It is a public-sector company under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
It is an attached office of NITI Aayog with no statutory basis
It is a joint venture of power-sector PSUs that distributes LED bulbs
new.x: BEE is a statutory body set up under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001 and functions under the Ministry of Power (operational from 1 March 2002). It is not under MNRE or NITI Aayog. The JV of power PSUs that distributes LEDs is EESL.
new.tq: BEE = statutory (EC Act 2001), Ministry of Power; EESL = JV company
